# relay_postgresql_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing managed PostgreSQL cluster in a workspace, by ID or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_postgresql_cluster" "billing" {
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "billing"
}

output "billing_regions" {
  value = [for r in data.relay_postgresql_cluster.billing.regions : "${r.cloud}/${r.region}: ${r.role}, ${r.phase}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Whether the platform refuses to delete the cluster.
- `distribution` (Attributes) The standby spread across regions. Null for a single-region cluster, and for a PostgreSQL cluster with a stretched distribution, which Terraform does not model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--distribution))
- `endpoint_host` (String) Public read-write endpoint host. Empty until the platform publishes it.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Public read-write endpoint port.
- `managed_by` (String) Owner tag, empty when unmanaged.
- `phase` (String)
- `private_endpoints` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_endpoints))
- `public_endpoints` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_endpoints))
- `ready_nodes` (Number)
- `regions` (Attributes Set) Per-region status of a standby distribution, one entry per region, empty for a single-region cluster. It is read from the platform and changes by itself, for example when a standby's replication link drops, so it never shows as drift. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))
- `shared_host` (String) The previous shared read-write address of a database upgraded from the Free plan. It keeps working, but is never `endpoint_host`. Empty when there is no such alias.
- `storage` (Attributes) Volume size and autoscaling of the whole cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage))
- `storage_status` (Attributes) Volume size the platform has grown to via autoscaling, when above `storage.size`. Null until it grows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_status))
- `total_nodes` (Number)
- `version` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud of the region.
- `endpoint` (String) Hostname of this region's own endpoint, on a standby region as well. Empty when the region has no DNS cell of its own and without the `region_endpoints` feature.
- `held` (String) Why the operator holds this region's role change; empty when nothing is held.
- `message` (String) Detail for the phase.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase of the cluster in this region.
- `ready_nodes` (Number) Nodes ready in this region.
- `region` (String) Region name.
- `replication_link` (String) `Up` or `Down` on a standby, as the operator reports it; empty on the primary.
- `role` (String) `primary` or `standby`.
- `total_nodes` (Number) Nodes expected in this region.
